French Fry & Cheese Wrap

A blend of two cuisines, packing a punch in one simple roll! This makes for the perfect quick recipe.

5 minPreparation
5 minCooking
1Servings

Ingredients

For 1 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Heat the chapattis on a frying pan or griddle and spread with butter.
  2. Arrange the salad leaves on the hot chapattis and arrange French fries on the lettuce.
  3. Spread Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup on top, and sprinkle with grated cheese.
  4. Roll up tightly to enclose the filling and serve.
